decisions.reason: This software remains very close to the firm's automation and data-management knowledge base and strategic move toward connected, data-driven infrastructure, so despite limited later web evidence the firm is more likely to keep learning from and refining it than withdraw it.

The product still draws on the firm's established infrastructure engineering experience, but as a more niche physical component and less central to the firm's digital direction it faces a higher withdrawal risk than the core automation offerings.

Control technology for water engineering machinery sits squarely in the firm's core combination of machinery, automation and service capabilities, giving it strong absorptive capacity to improve and retain it.

Flow measurement automation and system software is closely related to the firm's existing software and process-automation base, and its internal R&D and research links make continued development more likely than discontinuation.
